author: National Geographic
description:
Paige Tingey, part of the Creator Cohort, is an accomplished landscape and adventure photographer whose work has taken her all around the globe. Now she takes her turn in the yellow chair to answer the Nat Geo 9. Find out which of the seven continents Paige would like to visit, two animals she'd like to see in person, and more.

Make sure to follow National Geographic and check out all the members of the inaugural Creator Cohort.

author: National Geographic
description: What are regenerative agriculture practices? At Waitrose Farms, these practices, including treating the soil with care, keeping the Earth covered in a variety of plants, using grazing animals, and keeping roots in the ground, are used to create a more resilient farm. Through regenerative agriculture, Waitrose is working to strengthen the system that feeds us.

description:
Presented by @ROLEX. Africa's rivers are at the center of its thriving biodiversity—and National Geographic Explorer Steve Boyes is on a mission to protect them for generations to come. 

Through its partnership with the National Geographic Society and as part of its Perpetual Planet Initiative, #Rolex supports expeditions exploring and protecting remarkable places around the world, a selection of which are featured in Africa Earth’s Wild Home. #PerpetualPlanet

Africa Earth's Wild Home, premieres Friday, October 2 at 8/7c on National Geographic. Streaming next day on @disneyplus and @hulu.
